summary: Executed full CoolPet backend API test suite (21 pytest cases) against external URL. All tests passed: root, auth (signup/login/me + duplicate/wrong-password/no-token/short-password), pets CRUD + IMEI lowercasing + geofence + history, IoT HEX ingest (matched w/ inside_geofence, unmatched, malformed), Stripe checkout (basic/pro/advanced + invalid), payments status polling, and WebSocket /api/ws/live broadcast within timeout.

minor.issue: Endpoint is public with no device shared-secret/mutual-TLS; noted as production hardening TODO in code comment.
Webhook is defined but Stripe signature verification depends on emergentintegrations lib; not tested end-to-end here (no real webhook events).
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); should migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~570 lines — still manageable but approaching the point where splitting into routers (auth, pets, iot, payments, ws) + services would improve maintainability.
IoT ingest endpoint has no auth; acknowledged in comment but should at least gate with a shared HMAC header before production.
Simulator loop writes to db.locations every 2 seconds per pet with no TTL/index; will grow unbounded. Add a TTL index on locations.timestamp or a size cap.
@app.on_event is deprecated in modern FastAPI; use lifespan handlers.
JWT_SECRET fallback is 'dev_secret'; current .env sets a real one — good — but consider raising if unset in production mode.
PetGeofenceUpdate PATCH allows partial nulls silently; consider validating that at least one field is provided (minor).
test_credentials: Seeded demo user ada@coolpet.io / secret123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test suite creates its own throwaway users via /api/auth/signup.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed pets and unique-email test users; created pet is deleted at end of suite. Other TEST_ pets/users remain in Mongo (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints incl. WebSocket. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. websocket-client is now installed. Simulator loop runs on startup broadcasting demo_device every 2s when no pets exist, and pet_update when pets exist.
